name: 茱迪·卡罗尔·哈里森
name_full: 茱迪·卡罗尔·哈里森 Jodi Carol Harrison
introduction: Jodi Carol Harrison studied under the late Uta Hagan and Earl Hyman at the HB studio. She is a member of the Ivana Chubbuck Studio. Their twelve step techniques have taught her to be present while making active choices and to allow the person (role) to emerge off the page. Her goal is to always have solid strong roots for this person and empathy for whomever she is in the scene with. In 1983, she was cast as a cheerleader for the NBC movie of the week, High School USA where she earned her SAG card. Newly married to her childhood sweetheart she decided to move back to New York to live near family. She and her husband reside in Los Angeles since 2008, while still keeping an apartment in Manhattan. Jodi and her husband are proud parents of their son who lives in New York. Putting her talent and ambition along with her Theater Arts degree, her move back to Los Angeles in 2008 has resulted in a variety of roles and she look's forward to her endless opportunities.
